class: A check that stops at the first sign the page is still the form (a visible Apply or Submit button) never reads a receipt that appears on a page which also has such a button
symptom: Rackspace (Workday): after the owner clicked Submit the page showed 'Congratulations! Your application has been successfully submitted.' but the agent kept waiting: the browser did not close and the status stayed 'ready to submit'.
site: rackspace.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com (Network Engineer IV - US), 2 November 2026; the owner's screenshot
root_cause: Rackspace goes back to the job posting after Submit and shows the receipt in a dialog over it. submission_confirmed returned False first thing when find_submit_button found a button, and the posting's own Apply button matches the submit label. Verizon shows a separate receipt page with no such button, so it worked.
why_tests_missed: The receipt tests (f286, f297) used pages with the receipt and no Apply button, and wording variations; none put the receipt in a dialog over a page that still has an Apply button.
fix: Before the 'still on the form' test, a visible dialog (role dialog, alertdialog or aria-modal) that holds fewer than three typed boxes is read with the shared receipt wording (confirmation_text): a receipt in it, with nothing left to do, counts. A dialog asking 'Are you sure you want to submit?', a verification prompt, a cookie notice, a hidden dialog or one holding a form does not.
prevention: A check that decides 'still on the form' from a button must also look for a receipt; test each way a site can show one (own page, banner, dialog over another page).
